# Criterion Domain

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CriterionDomain`](gmeow-CriterionDomain.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CriterionDomain>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The subject domain of a criterion — an OPEN value vocabulary (relational, factual, aesthetic, safety, stylistic, …). Open: evaluation traditions disagree about the domain inventory itself ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CriterionDomain`](gmeow-CriterionDomain.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
